interpretation: The client was healthy immediately before the close. The WhatsApp edge sent a 24-byte segment and then reset the TCP connection (RST); the client reconnected 4.2s later to a different edge IP. This is not a keepalive failure or event-loop stall.
captureIssue: tcpdump was buffered and the watcher copied the file before the last 2.5 minutes were flushed. Stopping tcpdump gracefully recovered the close packets. The unit now uses -U --immediate-mode.
